title: Pi with a local model
description: Pi with a model on your own server (Ollama, LM Studio, llama.cpp, vLLM or another OpenAI-compatible one) and nothing else: only the server's address is opened, with the model's real context window and the loop guard.

de.title: Pi mit einem lokalen Modell
de.description: Pi mit einem Modell auf Ihrem eigenen Server (Ollama, LM Studio, llama.cpp, vLLM oder ein anderer OpenAI-kompatibler) und sonst nichts: nur die Adresse des Servers ist offen, mit dem echten Kontextfenster des Modells und dem Schleifenschutz.

llm.label: LLM server (sandbox-ai llm list), NAME or NAME:MODEL
llm.hint: sandbox-ai llm add ollama --kind ollama --url http://127.0.0.1:11434 --model MODEL

notes: Register the server once: sandbox-ai llm add NAME --kind ollama|lmstudio|llamacpp|vllm|openai-compatible --url URL --model MODEL; sandbox-ai llm check NAME --agent pi asks it for the API Pi uses.

sandbox-ai's extension gives Pi the server as its provider sandbox-ai (OpenAI chat completions at the server's /v1 URL, the key a placeholder the connection proxy replaces, the model's context window as the start's num_ctx or the server says), and Pi starts with --model sandbox-ai/MODEL. LM Studio, Ollama, vLLM and llama.cpp all work.

The loop guard: its instructions in Pi's system prompt and its turn limit (the extension ends a run there), the relay's model parameters (sandbox-ai llm params) on the wire. Agents need a model with tool calls and a long context (qwen3-coder, gpt-oss, ...; Ollama: OLLAMA_CONTEXT_LENGTH=32768 or more). On this host's loopback (http://127.0.0.1:PORT) only with Podman.
Its image first: sandbox-ai build pi.
